next.reason: 1985: "01 {data-name-1|FILLER} ... [ IS EXTERNAL ] [ IS GLOBAL ]"; 2023: "level-number [ entry-name-clause ] ... [ IS EXTERNAL [ AS literal-1 ] ] [ IS GLOBAL ]". 2023 covers the same entry with EXTERNAL and GLOBAL, but makes the entry name optional, adds EXTERNAL AS literal-1 and many more clauses and usages, so more programs are accepted.
